Package com.framed.communicator.driver.protocol.mimic

Class WfdbHeader

java.lang.Object
com.framed.communicator.driver.protocol.mimic.WfdbHeader
public final class WfdbHeader extends Object
A parsed WFDB header (.hea) file, covering the three header flavours used by the MIMIC-III Waveform Database:
  • Master (multi-segment) header — its record line carries a /numSegments suffix and it lists one WfdbHeader.Segment per line instead of signal specifications. Segments whose name is "~" are gaps (WfdbHeader.Segment.gap()); the _layout segment has zero length and points at the layout header.
  • Layout header — a single-segment header whose signal lines use the placeholder file "~" and format 0; it establishes the canonical signal order, gains and names for a variable-layout record.
  • Segment header — a single-segment header whose signal lines reference a real .dat file; this is the source of truth for decoding that segment.

The parser is deliberately lenient: comment lines (starting with #) and blank lines are skipped, and trailing optional numeric fields on a signal line may be omitted.
